Isaura was very communicative from the start of the project to the end. Hector and his crew do a great job!  I will definitely use them again for remodels! Some before and after pictures for your viewing pleasure.
Absolutely love these countertops and the quality of the work! This is the second time we've used H&I for our countertops and it won't be the last, a really great team to work with❤
